shortDescription: Keeps lodestone bindings, fixes the needle aboard airships and adds a compass that always points north
oneLiner: Your lodestone compass stops forgetting where it was bound, the needle stays steady aboard a Create Aeronautics airship, and a craftable World Compass always points true north — in the Nether and the End too.

configKeys.effect: Keeps a lodestone compass bound unless the lodestone is provably gone, instead of dropping the binding whenever vanilla's POI lookup comes back empty (which also happens for an unloaded chunk or an unreadable POI file).

Corrects the compass needle inside Sable sub-levels (Create Aeronautics airships), using the interpolated render pose instead of Sable's previous-tick pose; turn it off if another mod fights over the same method.

Repairs the needle where Quark's 'Compasses Work Everywhere' takes it over (aim at block centre instead of the north-west corner, honour Sable sub-levels, keep an item frame's rotation steps); without Quark it does nothing.

Adds the World Compass recipe — a compass that always points north in world space, including the Nether, the End and aboard a turning airship. NOTE: only the recipe is actually gated; the item itself is registered regardless (see notes).

events: net.neoforged.neoforge.event.AddReloadListenerEvent — NeoForge game bus, handler on the module instance (CompassOverhaulModule.onAddReloadListener, lines 101-107; the instance is registered with NeoForge.EVENT_BUS.register(this) in onInitialize, line 91); adds a PreparableReloadListener that injects the World Compass recipe, gated on isModuleEnabled() && getConfig().isWorldCompassEnabledValue()

net.neoforged.fml.event.lifecycle.FMLClientSetupEvent — mod bus, @EventBusSubscriber(value = Dist.CLIENT, bus = EventBusSubscriber.Bus.MOD) on CompassOverhaulClientSetup (annotation line 21, handler lines 27-33); registers the 'minecraft:angle' item property function for the World Compass via event.enqueueWork. NOT gated on the module or on world_compass_enabled — the annotation is scanned by FML independently of the module manager

(indirect) net.neoforged.neoforge.event.BuildCreativeModeTabContentsEvent — not subscribed by the module itself; the item supplier is handed to the shared core helper VanillaPlusCreativeTabs.addToMainTab(WORLD_COMPASS) in onInitialize (CompassOverhaulModule.java:90), and core's own handler (VanillaPlusCreativeTabs.onBuildCreativeModeTabContents, lines 55-63) accepts it into the vanillaplusadditions:main tab
mixins: compass_overhaul.LodestoneTrackerMixin — @Mixin(LodestoneTracker.class); @Inject(method = "tick", at = HEAD, cancellable = true) keepBindingWithoutProof(ServerLevel, CallbackInfoReturnable<LodestoneTracker>); listed in the "mixins" (both-sides) block of vanillaplusadditions.mixins.json:15, but the target method only runs server-side

compass_overhaul.CompassAngleSubLevelMixin (client) — @Mixin(value = CompassItemPropertyFunction.class, priority = 1500); @Inject at HEAD of getAngleFromEntityToPos, cancellable = true, require = 0; listed in the "client" block (vanillaplusadditions.mixins.json:30)

compass_overhaul.QuarkCompassAngleMixin (client) — @Mixin(targets = "org.violetmoon.quark.content.tweaks.client.item.CompassAnglePropertyFunction", remap = false); two @Inject(at = HEAD, cancellable = true, remap = false) on getAngleToPosition and getFrameRotation; listed in the "client" block (vanillaplusadditions.mixins.json:31)
recipes: Shaped `vanillaplusadditions:world_compass` — pattern " A " / "ECE" / " E " with A = Amethyst Shard (Items.AMETHYST_SHARD), E = Eye of Ender (Items.ENDER_EYE), C = Compass (Items.COMPASS), CraftingBookCategory.MISC, result one World Compass (default stack count 1). Built in code (CompassOverhaulModule.applyWorldCompassRecipe, lines 110-127) and re-applied on every server resource reload through the inner WorldCompassRecipeReloadListener (lines 129-148) added in AddReloadListenerEvent; only added when the module is enabled AND world_compass_enabled = true. It copies the existing recipe map into a LinkedHashMap, puts the holder in and calls RecipeManager.replaceRecipes(merged.values()).

optionalMods.whatItAdds: Sable (the Create Aeronautics sub-level layer) enables the airship needle correction: with it, the ordinary compass and the World Compass keep pointing at the real target while the ship turns, computed from the interpolated renderPose(partialTick). Without Sable, SableGate.isLoaded() is false, SableOrientation is never touched (so its Sable classes are never resolved) and the needle falls back to vanilla/Quark behaviour — aboard a ship it then points at 'ship north'. Parts A, C and D still work. Optional in the ModList sense only: there is no shouldInitialize() override anywhere in the module, so the module always initialises.
optionalMods.evidence: src/main/java/net/geraldhofbauer/vanillaplusadditions/modules/compass_overhaul/compat/SableGate.java:28 (ModList.get().isLoaded("sable"), cached in a Boolean field); compat/SableOrientation.java:36-38 in-file lines 3-5 (the only Sable imports in the module: ClientSubLevelAccess, SableCompanion, math.Pose3dc) and :82 (SableCompanion.INSTANCE.getContainingClient(viewer) — an instance call on INSTANCE, not a static); mixin/compass_overhaul/CompassAngleSubLevelMixin.java:38 and mixin/compass_overhaul/QuarkCompassAngleMixin.java:53 (both call sites sit behind SableGate.isLoaded()); build.gradle:140-147 (compileOnly + localRuntime on libs/sable-neoforge-*.jar / sable-companion-*.jar, skipped when the fileTree is empty); src/main/resources/META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml:97-103 (bundle only: optional, side=CLIENT, versionRange [1.2.2,)). The generated standalone toml declares NO sable dependency at all — renderModuleToml (build.gradle:507-530) emits only vpa_core/neoforge/minecraft required plus an 'incompatible' entry on the bundle.

optionalMods.whatItAdds: Only relevant when Quark's 'Compasses Work Everywhere' is on: it replaces the compass angle function per item, so an ordinary compass no longer reaches CompassItemPropertyFunction at all. This module patches Quark's replacement in place — aim at Vec3.atCenterOf(target) instead of the raw (north-west corner) block position, route through SableOrientation when aboard a ship, and use ItemFrame.getVisualRotationYInDegrees() so an item frame's eight rotation steps are kept. Without Quark, Mixin disables QuarkCompassAngleMixin (both the bundle and the generated per-module mixin config are "required": false) and nothing is lost. Note that with Quark present and fix_quark_compass = false, part B (fix_sublevel_needle) is silently void for ordinary compasses.
optionalMods.evidence: src/main/java/net/geraldhofbauer/vanillaplusadditions/mixin/compass_overhaul/QuarkCompassAngleMixin.java:41-42 (string target, remap = false), :62-63 (Vec3.atCenterOf + atan2), :73 (frame.getVisualRotationYInDegrees()); src/main/resources/vanillaplusadditions.mixins.json:2 and build.gradle:496 (both mixin configs "required": false); no quark entry in neoforge.mods.toml, no ModList check for quark anywhere in the module, and no compile reference from this module (build.gradle:160 pulls Quark+Zeta compileOnly for the pathfinder_quills module)

notes:
FOUR PARTS, ONE SWITCH EACH. A = guard_lodestone_binding (server), B = fix_sublevel_needle (client), C = world_compass_enabled (item + recipe), D = fix_quark_compass (client). The module Javadoc (CompassOverhaulModule.java:36-56) and docs/modules/compass_overhaul.md:5-12 both say "four"; the README paragraph still opens with "Three repairs around the compass" and then describes all four — README is stale on the count (README.md:121).

README LINK IS STALE IN THE WORKING TREE: README.md:121 and :301 still link docs/compass_overhaul.md, but the file has been renamed (staged, uncommitted docs reorg) to docs/modules/compass_overhaul.md — docs/compass_overhaul.md no longer exists on disk. Content of the doc itself is unchanged by that rename. README.md:235 additionally lists the module in the optional-mods table with Sable only (no Quark row).

world_compass_enabled=false DOES NOT REMOVE THE ITEM. onInitialize() registers the DeferredItem and adds it to the creative tab unconditionally (CompassOverhaulModule.java:72-73 for the DeferredItem, :89-90 for ITEMS.register(getModEventBus()) + VanillaPlusCreativeTabs.addToMainTab); only the recipe is gated (line 103). So with world_compass_enabled=false the World Compass is still registered, still in the creative tab and still works — it is merely uncraftable. Only disabling the whole module removes the item (and then existing stacks lose their item).

CLIENT SETUP IS NOT GATED (unverified crash risk, inferred, not observed): CompassOverhaulClientSetup is an FML-scanned @EventBusSubscriber, so its FMLClientSetupEvent handler runs even when the module is disabled in config. A disabled module never reaches onInitialize (ModuleManager only calls initialize() for modules ModulesConfig.isModuleEnabled() accepted, ModuleManager.java:90-108), so ITEMS.register(modEventBus) never happens and WORLD_COMPASS is an unbound DeferredHolder — yet the handler calls WORLD_COMPASS.get() (CompassOverhaulClientSetup.java:30) with no isActive() check. By NeoForge's DeferredHolder semantics that throws on an unbound holder, which would mean a client-side failure whenever compass_overhaul is switched off. This is deduced from the source, not reproduced; it is the only @EventBusSubscriber client-setup class in the repo, so there is no sibling pattern to compare against.

DEAD CODE: the public static CompassOverhaulModule.worldCompassEnabled() (lines 195-198) is never called anywhere in src/ — the recipe gate reads getConfig().isWorldCompassEnabledValue() directly (line 103). The other three statics are the live mixin gates: guardsLodestone() → LodestoneTrackerMixin:34, fixesSubLevelNeedle() → CompassAngleSubLevelMixin:38, fixesQuarkCompass() → QuarkCompassAngleMixin:50 and :68. isActive() is only used from inside those three. No TODO/FIXME comments anywhere in the module or its mixins.

MIXIN FRAGILITY (part B): Sable @Overwrite's the same method. CompassAngleSubLevelMixin therefore uses priority = 1500 and require = 0 (a missed binding must not crash), which deviates from the config-wide "injectors": {"defaultRequire": 1} (vanillaplusadditions.mixins.json:34-36). If it ever silently stops binding, the symptom is "nothing happens", not a crash. The escape hatch is fix_sublevel_needle = false.

SUB-LEVEL BEARING ONLY FOR A VIEWER INSIDE THE PLOT: SableOrientation.bearingInSubLevel returns empty unless SableCompanion.INSTANCE.getContainingClient(viewer) finds a sub-level, i.e. the viewer really stands in the plot. A player riding a seat on a hull drawn out in the world is deliberately NOT converted — an earlier version used getTrackingOrVehicleSubLevel and that was the beta.85 bug (needle off by the ship's whole rotation, half a turn on a backwards ship; CHANGELOG 1.0.0-beta.85, and the same reasoning in the commit body of 1ea3133). Do not "improve" that back.

UNIT MISMATCH: vanilla's angle function works in turns, Quark's in radians. SableOrientation returns turns (it divides by 2π, SableOrientation.java:92). QuarkCompassAngleMixin multiplies that bearing back by 2π (line 57, FULL_TURN); CompassAngleSubLevelMixin passes it through unchanged (line 97). Easy to get wrong when editing either.

PART D SILENTLY VOIDS PART B: because ItemProperties is keyed per item, Quark's registration means an ordinary compass never reaches CompassItemPropertyFunction. In a pack with Quark, part B alone only affects items that still use the vanilla function — notably the World Compass.

LODESTONE GUARD SEMANTICS: binding kept while the chunk is unloaded, kept while a lodestone still stands there, handed back to vanilla (which clears it) only when the chunk is loaded and the block is provably something else. A target in another dimension (LodestoneTrackerMixin:42-44) and a target outside world bounds (:46-48) are left to vanilla untouched. Breaking a lodestone in a loaded chunk still unbinds immediately. The mixin only fires when tracked() is true and target() is present (:38-40).

WORLD COMPASS NEEDLE: no hand-rolled maths — vanilla's CompassItemPropertyFunction is handed a target 4,000,000 blocks due north (negative Z) of the viewer in the viewer's own dimension (WorldCompassAngle.java:30 NORTH_DISTANCE, :74-78 create()). That is why it works in the Nether/End (vanilla only rejects a target from a different dimension) and why part B applies to it. An earlier hand-derived formula pointed south (CHANGELOG 1.0.0-beta.84).

MODELS/TEXTURES: 32 texture frames world_compass_00..31.png and 32 model JSONs — the base world_compass.json plus 31 sub-models; world_compass_16.json is intentionally absent because the base model IS frame 16 (its layer0 is vanillaplusadditions:item/world_compass_16 and, of its 33 overrides, the two for angle 0.0 and 0.984375 map back to world_compass itself — verified by parsing the JSON). Do not "fix" the gap. The PNGs are recoloured vanilla compass frames generated by scripts/gen_world_compass_textures.py from a client jar and committed — i.e. DERIVED MOJANG ASSETS; worth a line in any public doc. The property is registered under the vanilla key minecraft:angle on purpose (ResourceLocation.withDefaultNamespace("angle"); the property map is keyed by item first).

RECIPE INJECTION RE-RUNS ON EVERY RELOAD and rebuilds the whole recipe map via RecipeManager.replaceRecipes — consistent with this repo's "recipes in code, never JSON" rule. There are no data/**/recipe/ or loot_table/ JSONs for this module.

BUILD: compiling this module needs libs/sable-neoforge-1.21.1-1.2.2.jar (and/or sable-companion-*.jar) on the compileOnly classpath, because SableOrientation.java imports dev.ryanhcode.sable.companion.* directly; build.gradle:140-147 silently skips the dependency when the fileTree is empty, so the failure shows up as a compile error rather than a clear message. Quark is NOT needed to build this module (string mixin target); the Quark/Zeta jars at build.gradle:160 are there for pathfinder_quills.

STANDALONE JAR: vpa_compass_overhaul (standalone/compass_overhaul/CompassOverhaulStandalone.java, @Mod("vpa_compass_overhaul"), delegating to StandaloneModuleBootstrap.boot), declared in build.gradle:407-410 with mixins = [compass_overhaul.LodestoneTrackerMixin] and clientMixins = [compass_overhaul.CompassAngleSubLevelMixin, compass_overhaul.QuarkCompassAngleMixin]. It has no dataGlobs — all assets (the 32 models, 32 textures and the lang entry) ship in vpa_core (the assets include is build.gradle:617), and every module jar declares a required dependency on vpa_core (build.gradle:510) plus an 'incompatible' dependency on the bundle (build.gradle:516). The bundle jar excludes standalone/** (build.gradle:364-367).

LANG: exactly one key, item.vanillaplusadditions.world_compass = "World Compass" (en_us.json:180); the introducing commit 1ea3133 added the same key to cs_cz:71, de_at:71, de_de:180, es_es:73 and fr_fr:71 (verified: six lang files, six added lines). No config or tooltip strings.

VERSION/TAG CAVEAT: the module directory was added in 1ea3133 (2026-09-18, the only commit touching modules/compass_overhaul/), one squashed commit that also added glider_lightning_guard. The CHANGELOG documents the module as introduced in 1.0.0-beta.82, with fixes in .83, .84 and .85 — but tags v1.0.0-beta.82 through .85 exist neither locally nor on origin (both jump from v1.0.0-beta.81 to v1.0.0-beta.86). git describe --contains 1ea3133 → v1.0.0-beta.86~3, so the earliest tag actually containing the commit is v1.0.0-beta.86; "shipped in beta.82" would be a CHANGELOG-only claim.

MODULE-SIDE ENABLED DEFAULT: neither CompassOverhaulModule nor CompassOverhaulConfig overrides isEnabledByDefault(); the interface default in core/Module.java:73-75 returns true and feeds the generic .define("enabled", module.isEnabledByDefault()) in AbstractModuleConfig:60, and shouldInitialize() is not overridden either (core/AbstractModule.java:112-114) — so there is no hard mod gate; the module always initialises when enabled. The generic 'enabled' and 'debug_logging' keys come from AbstractModuleConfig (lines 60 and 66) and are deliberately not listed under configKeys.

TESTING NOTE: per the repo's CLAUDE.md there are no unit tests, and Quark/Zeta have deliberately no localRuntime (build.gradle:152-160), so parts B and D are not verifiable in runClient — they need the deployed jar in a real 1.21.1 instance with Quark/Sable present.
